{{Top}}
An '''electromagnetic field''' was a physical [[Force field/Legends|field]] produced by electrically charged objects.<ref name="SOTE">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> When a [[Gas/Legends|gas]] was ionized either through high [[Temperature/Legends|temperatures]] or the use of an electromagnetic field, [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] was created.<ref name="BMF14">{{BuildFalconCite|14|Guide to the Galaxy}}</ref>
